name: rfdiffusion3

settings.name: task
settings.description: Task to perform

settings.name: pdbFile
settings.description: Pdb structure file to be designed - contains both protein and ligand

settings.name: jsonInputType
settings.description: Choose whether to upload a JSON file or enter JSON config as a string

settings.name: jsonFile
settings.description: Foundry-style JSON config file (see https://github.com/RosettaCommons/foundry/blob/production/models/rfd3/docs/input.md for format)

settings.name: jsonConfig
settings.description: Foundry-style JSON config as a string (see https://github.com/RosettaCommons/foundry/blob/production/models/rfd3/docs/input.md for format)

settings.name: inputFiles
settings.description: PDB/CIF files referenced in your JSON config. Files are matched based on filename.

settings.name: targetChains
settings.description: Chain IDs of target

settings.name: hotspots
settings.description: Residues to focus on on your target when designing a binder

settings.name: binderLength
settings.description: Range of binder length to sample from

settings.name: ligands
settings.description: Select ligands to target from your pdb

settings.name: smBinderConditions
settings.description: Specify conditioning for ligand atoms (Fixed, Buried, Exposed).

settings.name: scaffoldingMode
settings.description: Choose atom-level scaffolding (fix individual atoms of motif residues) or residue-level scaffolding (specify interface residues and designed-region lengths, motif contigs assembled for you).

settings.name: interfaceChain
settings.description: Chain ID of chain with interface to be scaffolded

settings.name: interfaceResidues
settings.description: Select interface residues to be kept in your final protein. You can then select designed region lengths for 1 more than the number of contiguous interface ranges you select below.

settings.name: designedLengths
settings.description: Length of the region to be designed between fixed residues - length (20) or range of lengths to sample uniformly (20-30)

settings.name: unindex
settings.description: Whether residue index be inferred by the model instead of prespecified (all by default or comma separated list of residues e.g. A109,A114)

settings.name: classifierFreeGuidance
settings.description: Enables classifier-free guidance to strictly enforce motif adherence. Increases computational cost by 2x.

settings.name: oriToken
settings.description: [x,y,z] origin override to control center of mass placement

settings.name: numDesigns
settings.description: Total designs to generate across the run. A production campaign is ~10,000 designs.

settings.name: diffusionBatchSize
settings.description: Designs per GPU pass (Foundry diffusion_batch_size). Defaults to 8. Designs in the same batch share sampled binder length. Extra designs may be generated if the leaf count does not divide evenly.

settings.name: nonLoopy
settings.description: Encourages the model to make more structured designs (recommended)

settings.name: stepScale
settings.description: Controls the diffusion update size. The default (1.5) promotes stable, idealized, and 'designable' structures. Lowering towards 1.0 reduces helical bias, increasing diversity. Increasing (>1.5) forces stricter convergence.

settings.name: gammaZero
settings.description: Controls how much extra noise is injected into the structure at every step of the reverse diffusion process. Decreasing tends to increase designability and decrease diversity.

settings.name: runDesignability
settings.description: After diffusion, redesign each backbone with ProteinMPNN and refold it with AlphaFold to report self-consistency RMSD, pLDDT, pTM and interface PAE. Adds runtime and cost. Single target chain only.

settings.name: useSolubleMpnn
settings.description: Use SolubleMPNN instead of ProteinMPNN when redesigning for the designability test. SolubleMPNN is trained only on soluble proteins, so it avoids exposed hydrophobic patches. Doesn't change the diffused backbones.

settings.name: claude_inference_optimization
settings.description: Enable Anthropic's optimized inference kernels for the diffusion step (https://www.anthropic.com/research/claude-uplifts-biomolecular-modeling). Exact is bit-identical to stock and faster on L40S. Fast trades float tolerance for lower per-batch latency, but pays a one-time ~67s graph-compile penalty on the first batch — only pick it when generating many designs across multiple diffusion batches. Not available with classifier-free guidance.

description: All atom protein design with atom-level and residue-level motif scaffolding

columns.name: pdb_filepath
columns.description: Generated de novo all-atom design structure (PDB).

columns.name: Sequence_A
columns.description: Amino-acid sequence of chain A of the generated design.

columns.name: max_ca_deviation
columns.description: Maximum C-alpha deviation of the design; a per-design geometry-quality metric. Lower is better.

columns.name: n_chainbreaks
columns.description: Number of backbone chain breaks in the generated design. Lower is better.

columns.name: radius_of_gyration
columns.description: Radius of gyration of the generated backbone.

columns.name: num_residues
columns.description: Number of residues in the generated design.
